en: The image depicts a grand Baroque building with a tall, ornate tower capped with a green dome, likely copper or oxidized bronze, which is typical in Central European architecture. In the foreground, an arched stone bridge crosses a river, and there are leafy green trees framing part of the scene. The word 'Dresden' is prominently featured at the bottom in white font. The postcard is bordered with a simple white frame.
